body: The server answers 422 unknown_list with row_id when a pushed item names a list the caller cannot write to (deleted, or left while offline) - see docs/wire-contract.md, Sync. Neither web/src/i18n/apiErrors.ts nor android ui/ErrorText.kt maps it, so on Android a parked item shows only the generic "Not saved to the list" (T-210) and the web shows its screen fallback. Add one sentence on both clients, identical English, nine locales, e.g. "This list is no longer available to you." Found while doing T-210.
title: unknown_list has no user-facing sentence on either client
